about: Which relying-party configurations RelyingParty accepts at construction. Shared byte-for-byte with the PHP twin (particle-academy/fancy-passkeys, tests/fixtures/relying-party/origins.json); change both in the same session. Plain http is allowed only for localhost and *.localhost (exact label match), IP-literal hosts are never allowed, and the RP ID must equal the origin's host or be a registrable suffix of it. Matches what Chromium accepts for WebAuthn: it accepts any *.localhost over http and refuses 127.0.0.1 as an RP ID.
